items.stem: Leadership rewards individuals for being 100% utilised. In an agile context this metric most likely:

options.text: Discourages collaboration and slack needed for flow and improvement
options.rationale: Correct: utilisation targets can harm flow, quality and collaboration.
High utilisation often slows value delivery.

options.text: Is the best measure of agility
options.rationale: Utilisation is not a measure of agility or value.
It does not directly improve outcomes.

items.stem: An agile leader best supports a self-managing team by:

options.text: Setting clear goals and removing impediments, then trusting the team to decide how
options.rationale: Correct: agile leaders enable and support rather than dictate the how.
Teams need clear goals to self-organise.

items.stem: Which TWO leadership actions most help an organisation become more agile? (Select TWO)

options.text: Removing systemic impediments that span teams
options.rationale: Correct: leaders can remove organisation-level blockers.

options.text: Aligning metrics and incentives with value and outcomes
options.rationale: Correct: incentives shape behaviour toward agility.

options.text: Mandating agility by decree without support
options.rationale: Mandates without support rarely change culture.

items.explanation: Correct: leaders can remove organisation-level blockers. Correct: incentives shape behaviour toward agility.
